import re, os, json

S02 = "/mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C10/public/snapshots/s02"
data = json.load(open('proc_writers.json'))
handlers = data['procops_writers']

COPY = re.compile(r'(memdup_user|vmemdup_user|copy_from_user|memcpy\s*\(\s*[^,]+,\s*page|simple_write_to_buffer)')
STRINGOPS = re.compile(r'\b(sscanf|simple_strtoul|simple_strtol|simple_strtoull|simple_strtoll|kstrtoul|kstrtol|kstrtouint|kstrtoint|strcmp|strncmp|strlen|strnlen|strchr|strscpy|strsep|strim|strstrip|strcpy|strstr|strpbrk|strlcpy|match_string|sysfs_match_string|strreplace|memparse)\s*\(')
TERM = re.compile(r"(\w+)\s*\[\s*(len|count|size|n|length|cnt|size_t|data_size|op_size|written)\s*\]\s*=\s*('\\\\0'|0)|memset\s*\(\s*(\w+)\s*,\s*0\s*,|memdup_user_nul|strndup_user|kmemdup_nul|kmalloc\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\+\s*1|kzalloc\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\+\s*1|kvmalloc\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\+\s*1")

out = []
for f, fns in sorted(handlers.items()):
    src = open(os.path.join(S02, f), errors='replace').read()
    lines = src.split('\n')
    for fn in fns:
        # locate function definition
        pat = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:static\s+)?(?:ssize_t|int|void)\s+' + re.escape(fn) + r'\s*\(', re.M)
        m = pat.search(src)
        if not m:
            continue
        start = src[:m.start()].count('\n') + 1
        # find end via brace matching
        i = src.find('{', m.start())
        depth = 0; end = i
        for j in range(i, len(src)):
            if src[j] == '{': depth += 1
            elif src[j] == '}':
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    end = j; break
        body = src[i:end]
        bodylines = body.count('\n') + 1
        copies = COPY.findall(body)
        strops = set(m.group(1) for m in STRINGOPS.finditer(body))
        term = bool(TERM.search(body))
        if copies and strops:
            out.append((f, fn, start, bodylines, sorted(strops), term))

print("Handlers with BOTH usercopy/copy and string ops:", len(out))
for f, fn, start, n, ops, term in out:
    print(f"{f}:{start} {fn} ({n} lines) strops={ops} terminator={term}")
EOF

import re, os

S02 = "/mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C10/public/snapshots/s02"
# directories to exclude from this tracefs/securityfs/misc-control sweep

targets = [
    'kernel/trace/trace.c',
    'kernel/trace/trace_events_user.c',
    'kernel/trace/trace_hwlat.c',
    'kernel/trace/trace_osnoise.c',
    'kernel/trace/trace_events_synth.c',
    'security/integrity/evm/evm_secfs.c',
    'security/integrity/ima/ima_fs.c',
    'security/tomoyo/securityfs_if.c',
    'security/apparmor/apparmorfs.c',
    'security/inode.c',
    'security/lockdown/lockdown.c',
    'security/safesetid/securityfs.c',
    'drivers/char/tpm/eventlog/common.c',
    'drivers/virt/coco/efi_secret/efi_secret.c',
    'security/loadpin/loadpin.c',
]

COPY = re.compile(r'(copy_from_user|memdup_user|simple_write_to_buffer|memcpy\s*\()')
STRINGOPS = re.compile(r'\b(sscanf|simple_strtoul|simple_strtol|simple_strtoull|kstrtoul|kstrtou64|kstrtouint|strcmp|strncmp|strlen|strnlen|strchr|strscpy|strcpy|strsep|strim|strstrip)\s*\(')
TERM = re.compile(r"(\w+)\[\s*(len|count|size|n|length|cnt)\s*\]\s*=\s*('\\0'|0)|memset\s*\(\s*\w+\s*,\s*0|memdup_user_nul|strndup_user|kmemdup_nul|\w+\s*\+\s*1\s*\)")

for f in targets:
    p = os.path.join(S02, f)
    if not os.path.exists(p): 
        print("missing:", f); continue
    src = open(p, errors='replace').read()
    for m in re.finditer(r'^\s*(?:static\s+)?(?:ssize_t|int)\s+(\w+)\s*\(\s*struct file\s*\*', src, re.M):
        fn = m.group(1)
        if not (fn.endswith('_write') or 'write' in fn): continue
        i = src.find('{', m.start())
        depth = 0; end = i
        for j in range(i, len(src)):
            if src[j] == '{': depth += 1
            elif src[j] == '}':
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0: end = j; break
        body = src[i:end]
        has_copy = bool(COPY.search(body))
        strops = set(x.group(1) for x in STRINGOPS.finditer(body))
        if has_copy and strops:
            term = bool(TERM.search(body))
            ln = src[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
            print(f"{f}:{ln} {fn} strops={sorted(strops)} terminator={term}")
EOF

import re, os

STRINGOPS = re.compile(r'\b(sscanf|simple_strtoul|simple_strtol|simple_strtoull|simple_strtoll|kstrtoul|kstrtol|kstrtouint|kstrtoint|kstrtou16|kstrtou8|strcmp|strncmp|strlen|strnlen|strchr|strscpy|strcpy|strsep|strim|strstrip|strpbrk|strreplace)\s*\(')
TERM = re.compile(r"(\w+)\[\s*(len|count|size|n|length|cnt|tmp_len)\s*\]\s*=\s*('\\0'|0)|memset\s*\(\s*\w+\s*,\s*0|memdup_user_nul|strndup_user|kmemdup_nul|__get_free_page")

for f in files:
    p = os.path.join(S02, f)
    src = open(p, errors='replace').read()
    # find all functions that are used as .write = in file, or any _write(struct file*
    fnames = set(re.findall(r'\.write\s*=\s*(\w+)', src))
    for fn in fnames:
        m = re.search(r'^\s*(?:static\s+)?(?:inline\s+)?(?:ssize_t|int|void)\s+' + re.escape(fn) + r'\s*\(', src, re.M)
        if not m: continue
        i = src.find('{', m.start())
        depth = 0; end = i
        for j in range(i, len(src)):
            if src[j] == '{': depth += 1
            elif src[j] == '}':
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0: end = j; break
        body = src[i:end]
        has_copy = bool(COPY.search(body))
        strops = set(x.group(1) for x in STRINGOPS.finditer(body))
        if has_copy and strops:
            term = bool(TERM.search(body))
            ln = src[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
            print(f"{f}:{ln} {fn} strops={sorted(strops)} terminator-evidence={term}")
EOF
